mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 2.0% fails to produce positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 4.5% fails to produce negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both increasing fails to produce positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production above 105.0 signals sustained economic momentum that produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO above 105.0 fails to produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month CPIAUCSL change exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 12m change above 3.0% fails to produce negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS positive month-over-month change fails to produce positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increasing and UNRATE decreasing fails to produce positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105.0 fails to produce positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances.
